text.tspan: Average learning outcomes vs. GDP per capita 2020
Average learning outcomes correspond to harmonized scores across standardized, psychometrically-robust
international and regional student achievement tests. GDP data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living
GDP per capita (international-$ in 2021 prices; plotted on a logarithmic axis)
